title: LIGHTKEEPER.GAME
heading: Lightkeeper
description: An exploration game built around traversal, discovery, and character encounters across a fog-covered archipelago. I led game design and production through a playable vertical slice.

title: KERN.GAME
heading: KERN
description: Designing an investigation game in which players observe anomalies, test their ideas with tools, and act on what they learn.

title: DRONIES.PRODUCTION
heading: Dronies
description: Led creative direction, art direction, and production across a digital-collectibles launch, connecting brand, product, web, comics, and a 3D community space.

title: FLAX.EDITOR
heading: Flax editor workflows
description: Redesigning our Flax game-engine editor workflows to make scene editing more predictable while building KERN.

title: DAEDALUS.PROJECT
heading: Daedalus
description: Created a science-fiction world across a live-action short, comic, and interactive reader. I wrote and designed the comic and produced, directed, and edited the film.

title: USERWISE.PRODUCT
heading: UserWise
description: Redesigned a live-ops content builder with Unfold to make complex authoring workflows clearer for mobile game teams.

title: MARATHON.TAU_CETI
heading: Marathon: Tau Ceti
description: Edited an in-universe account of the fall of Tau Ceti IV, using recovered logs, damaged signals, and motion design to tell the story.

title: SWAMP_FELLAS.GAME
heading: Swamp Fellas
description: Prototyped multiplayer gameplay while testing how fishing, character animation, and short scenes could communicate the game in public devlogs.

title: BOLT.UNITY
heading: Bolt 2.0 interface and icons
description: Led UI/UX redesign work for Bolt 2.0 and created 278 icons for Unity API functions, testing the interface and symbols directly in-engine.

title: LAZARIS.WEBSITE
heading: Lazaris
description: Developed the Lazaris studio website from the team’s existing design, implementing responsive layouts, interactions, and content structure.

title: PROTOTYPES.DIR
heading: Prototypes
description: Gameplay and tool experiments built to test a specific question before committing to a larger project.

title: GAME_JAMS.DIR
heading: Game jams
description: Small games built and released under jam constraints, including the original project that grew into Lightkeeper.

title: APPS.DIR
heading: Apps
description: Desktop tools for planning, composing, finding sounds, mapping game systems, and preparing video clips.

title: CLIENT_WORK.DIR
heading: Client work
description: Product design, websites, and implementation work for clients, including collaborative projects with Unfold.

title: VISUAL_LAB.DIR
heading: Visual lab
description: Motion, 3D, identity, and interaction studies exploring how an idea can look and behave.

title: VERTICAL_SLICE.2026
heading: Lightkeeper vertical slice
description: Playthroughs and demonstrations of Lightkeeper’s current traversal, character interactions, progression, and authoring tools.

title: TECHNICAL_TEST.DIR
heading: Lightkeeper technical test
description: Early experiments testing Lightkeeper’s visual direction, traversal, world scale, and authoring workflows.

title: FELL_OUT.CONCEPT
heading: Fell Out concept
description: The high-concept work that secured funding to develop the game-jam idea into a larger exploration game.

title: FELL_OUT.GAMEJAM
heading: Fell Out game jam
description: A 2023 Ludum Dare adventure about a stranded wolf exploring the Barracuda Islands. This small game became the starting point for Lightkeeper.

title: CREATIVES.DIR
heading: Dronies creative work
description: Brand, product, web, comics, and merchandise from the collaborative Dronies production, with individual creative credits.

title: METAVERSE_BUNKER.DIR
heading: Dronies Bunker
description: Directed a shared 3D space where Dronies holders could meet inside the project’s world, working with a developer to build the experience.

title: ORIGIN_ESTAFOS_SURAYA
heading: Estafos & Suraya
description: The narrative and image-making experiment that established the story and visual direction for Daedalus.

title: COMIC.DIR
heading: Daedalus comic
description: Wrote and designed a 12-page science-fiction comic, then connected animated panels through an interactive web reader.

title: BRAND.DIR
heading: Daedalus identity and merchandise
description: Identity, apparel, and print work extending Daedalus beyond the comic and film, created with credited collaborators.

title: FILM.DIR
heading: Daedalus Alpha
description: Produced, directed, and edited a seven-minute science-fiction short with a 12-person cast and crew during an overnight shoot.

title: BEHIND_THE_SCENES.DIR
heading: Daedalus Alpha behind the scenes
description: Behind the scenes of Daedalus Alpha’s overnight shoot with nine crew members and three cast members.

title: VOID_OVERDRIVE.DIR
heading: Void Overdrive
description: Tested whether fast hoverbike exploration could support a slower survival game. The prototype exposed an unresolved conflict between those two experiences.

title: PROJECT_HYPNO.DIR
heading: Project Hypno
description: A two-week horror prototype testing atmosphere, tactile interaction, and spatial anomalies before attempting a larger gameplay framework.

title: PROJECT_SUNSHINE.DIR
heading: Project Sunshine
description: Turned a world concept into a one-week Blender film mock-up, using one song to shape the sequence and mood.

title: MIGHTY_PEBBLE.DIR
heading: Mighty Pebble
description: A resource-gathering clicker prototype that led me to reconsider 3D in favor of a 2D presentation.

title: MATTERCRAFT.DIR
heading: Mattercraft
description: A card-based crafting prototype combining material recipes and a clicker economy, with automation as a direction for further development.

title: SPACEKEEPER.DIR
heading: Spacekeeper
description: A one-week space-station prototype testing gathering, survival, and a daily routine, with particular attention to interface and sound feedback.

title: FOX_STORIES.DIR
heading: Fox Stories
description: An atmospheric exploration prototype whose trailer reached 1.6 million views on Imgur. The response outpaced the implemented gameplay loop.

title: KCD_COMBAT.DIR
heading: Combat prototype
description: A combat-interaction prototype, presented as a gameplay test.

title: LEVEL_DESIGN.DIR
heading: Grand Bazaar blockout
description: Recreated Grand Bazaar from Battlefield 3 to study scale, sightlines, cover, and iteration in a real-time CSG blockout workflow.

title: MOVING_ON_EXPRESS
heading: Moving On Express
description: Designed and built a one-week moving-company game in which players load a truck quickly while avoiding damage to a family’s belongings.

title: LOOOOP.GAME
heading: LOOOOP
description: A playable orbital-survival game about controlling a dying world’s temperature while defending it from meteoroids and space debris.

title: FELL_OUT.LNK
heading: Fell Out game jam
description: View the original Fell Out game-jam project and its place in Lightkeeper’s development.
